articles.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
articles.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

articles.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
articles.description: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.

articles.title: Ukraine hit by strikes after Russia agrees to new peace talks
articles.description: The three waves of Russian missiles were launched at hours after Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks with the US and Ukraine.

articles.title: At least 153 people killed in drone strike on disputed Sudan-South Sudan region
articles.description: A drone strike on a fuel depot in a disputed region on the Sudan-South Sudan border has killed at least 153 people.
